results.scenario: Diabetic for 5 years; admitted for a diabetes complication; policy 12 months old.
results.rationale: Pre-existing disease covered only after 36 months of continuous cover.
results.summary: The diabetes complication is treated as a pre‑existing disease and the 36‑month pre‑existing disease waiting period has not been met (policy only 12 months old).
rejectionRisks: Pre‑existing disease waiting period of 36 months not satisfied (policy age 12 months).

results.scenario: Inpatient Ayurvedic treatment at a recognised hospital.
results.rationale: AYUSH in-patient treatment covered up to the sum insured.
results.summary: In‑patient AYUSH treatment at a recognised hospital is covered, assuming the 30‑day initial waiting period has been satisfied.
rejectionRisks: If the policy is less than 30 days old, the initial waiting period would block the claim.
Room‑rent and ICU charges are subject to a cap of 1%/2% of the Sum Insured per day.
A 10% co‑payment applies if the insured is over 60 years old at the time of hospitalisation.

results.scenario: Is my surgery covered? (no other details given)
results.rationale: Calibration rule: with missing facts, the tool must say Unclear, not guess.
results.summary: Coverage cannot be determined without knowing the type of surgery, its cause and the policy’s age.
rejectionRisks: Initial waiting period not satisfied if policy is less than 30 days old
Specific‑illness waiting period (24 months) if surgery is cataract, hernia, BPH or hysterectomy
Exclusion of cosmetic surgery unless caused by accident, burn or cancer
